issues: revenue_segment FY2022Q4: prior_year_comparative omitted (FY2021 annual restated to 68,872 but no restated FY2021 9M published).

orders_segment: no prior-year order amounts printed (YoY % only) → builder must use prior points; basis breaks at FY2022Q4 (annual on reclassified basis vs old-basis 9M) and FY2023 (EM vs 電力機器; FY2022 EM-basis orders not printed).
FY2015 and earlier not stored (used only as FY2016 prior_year_comparative for sales).

orders_segment FY2022Q4: removed at verification 2026-09-25. The only derivable value (FY2022 annual 84,533 − 9M 60,219 = 24,314) mixes bases: the annual figure is on the reclassified (≈EM) basis (2023-05-10 決算短信 p.4 prints +16.2% vs a restated FY2021 base; FY2023 EM orders 128,788 +52.4% confirms 84,533 as the EM-basis FY2022 total) while the 9M cumulative is old 電力機器 basis. The FY2023Q3 EM 9M +54.7% implies a same-basis FY2022 9M ≈ 60.7bn, so the hybrid Q4 overstated the quarter by ~0.5bn (~2%). A same-basis FY2022 9M figure was never printed, and deriving one from YoY % is ratio back-calculation, so the quarter is left empty.

structural_breaks.note: 中国電機製造 (Hiroshima; transformers, switchboards) consolidated from Q2 FY2015 — lifts FY2016Q1 YoY vs FY2015Q1.
Accounting change (not restated): 収益認識会計基準 adopted; 電力機器 FY2021 sales −387m vs old method (9M −420m).

FY2021 電力機器 full year restated 68,507→68,872 (溶接メカトロ −365) in the FY2022 annual 決算短信 without restated quarters; FY2022 annual 電力機器 (75,371) is on the reclassified basis that equals the later エネルギーマネジメント segment, while FY2022 Q1–Q3 are old basis. FY2022Q4 therefore = 75,371 − EM-basis 9M 50,490; no FY2022Q4 comparative. ダイヘン電機システム (sales subsidiary) merged 2022-04-01 (no scope change). Orders too: the FY2022 annual table prints 電力機器 orders 84,533 (+16.2% YoY, i.e. vs a restated FY2021 base ≈72.7bn, not the originally printed 72,408) on the same reclassified basis, while FY2022 Q1–Q3 order cumulatives (20,965/39,793/60,219) are old basis; no same-basis FY2022 9M orders were published (verify 2026-09-25).

Segments re-cut to technology domains: 電力機器事業→エネルギーマネジメント (transformers, 受変電設備, 制御通信機器, 充電システム, 分散電源). FY2022 recast EM cumulative: Q1 14,980 / H1 31,469 / 9M 50,490 / FY 75,371 (vs old 14,956 / 31,367 / 50,276 / 75,371); used as FY2023 prior_year_comparative.
東北電機製造 (70%, distribution transformers/switchboards, FY2022 sales 8,327m) and 四変テック (38.6%→65.3%, transformers/switchboards) consolidated into エネルギーマネジメント from Q3 FY2023.
